entries.official_publisher: Consumer, Building and Occupational Services Tasmania / Department of Justice Tasmania (both identified, both inaccessible)
entries.official_product_name: CBOS Rental Bond Statistics; DOJ Rental Bonds Output Data
entries.access_method: blocked — both cbos.tas.gov.au and justice.tas.gov.au return HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue' challenge page
entries.reason: Live-verified in Workstream 6 (2026-07-22): both identified official Tasmanian government rental-bond data pages are behind Cloudflare bot protection. This project's guardrails explicitly forbid bypassing Cloudflare/CAPTCHA/anti-bot protection, so this source cannot be built even though the underlying data is genuinely free and official.
entries.verification_note: RESOLVED (was 'search-only' in Workstream 2, now live-verified as definitively blocked in Workstream 6). A third-party mirror (Tenants' Union of Tasmania quarterly rent statistics, tutas.org.au) republishes figures derived from the same underlying bond-lodgement data, but is an advocacy organisation, not an official government/statutory source, so it does not satisfy this project's 'official sources only' rule regardless of accessibility. TAS rent coverage is finalised as blocked_access; no adapter will be built.
